notes.title: Obscurant v1.1.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Fixed[/h2]

- Fixed possible softlock in the Kingdom region.

notes.title: Obscurant v1.1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Tweaked level colliders in several Kurtovsk levels to improve visual consistency.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where certain input devices (such as the Steam Deck) would not display the correct button icons.
[*] Fixed minor animation bugs that could occur when in combat.
[/list]

notes.title: Obscurant v1.1.0 - Patch Notes (Improved Controller Support!)
notes.notes:
[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a virtual keyboard in the notebook for typing with a controller.
[*] Added Chapter Select feature to the main menu after completing the game.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved idle animations for certain enemies and their corresponding disguises.
[*] Improved menu navigation when using a controller.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where menu navigation could break when quitting to the main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where confirmation modals would sometimes become stuck in certain menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Obscurant v1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added “Close” button prompt to notebook UI.
[*] Made it so that the mouse cursor is always hidden except when needed for certain UIs.
[*] Added color tint to enemies that are currently following the player when using one of the Kurtovsk disguises.
[*] Made minor visual updates and improvements across most areas.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where enemies would sometimes alert while in a cutscene.
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available on Mac and Linux!
notes.notes:
[h3]Obscurant is now available on Mac and Linux![/h3]

That's right, you can now experience the mysteries of the Obscurance on macOS and SteamOS + Linux. Check out the Store Page for further information on supported operating systems and system requirements.

To go along with this, we've also enabled Steam Cloud support for Obscurant save files. This will allow you carry over your progress between your different machines.

Questions? Join the official Obscurant Discord to chat with developers and fellow players:
https://discord.com/invite/WJmZYqNB8y

notes.title: Obscurant v1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made it so that movement carries over between levels if the button is still held down.
[*] Updated Kingdom chase sequence to have a clearer and easier path.
[*] Improved visibility of Kurtovsk entrance.
[*] Updated the notebook to maintain the last opened page across levels.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed soft lock that could occur when skipping the first disguise in Kurtovsk.
[*] Fixed bug where enemies were able to move through walls on rare occasions.
[*] Fixed bug where player could temporarily avoid scripted deaths.
[*] Fixed bug where combat disguise indicator would show the wrong disguise number.
[*] Fixed minor animation bugs with the player character.
[*] Fixed minor visual layering issues.
[*] Fixed various minor dialogue issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Obscurant Is Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39095809/27b2b341ffaeb168543f9d5121aabd8fd5a3e3c1.png[/img]

[h1]Play Obscurant Today![/h1]

After more than two years of development, [b]Obscurant[/b] is finally released! It's been a long road, but we can't wait for players to experience the world of Obscurant.

Obscurant is a narrative-focused mimicry game in which you disguise as your enemies and mimic their behavior to blend in. You play as a curious robot exploring a mysterious world. Learn the origins of the Obscurance, and make friends in a dangerous world.


[url=https://twitter.com/ObscurantGame]Follow us on Twitter.[/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/WJmZYqNB8y]Join the Community Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Demo Livestream and Dev Chat!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39095809/8eb4106ed12efc7450cdb9b2fd58d5ecc58fbfbb.png[/img]

[h1]King Brick Games will be streaming gameplay of Obscurant live on Steam on [b]Wednesday, October 6th at 7:30PM EDT / 4:30PM PDT[/b]. Come hang out, learn about Obscurant, and celebrate Next Fest with us![/h1]

[h3]When you're done watching, try the demo for yourself! You will be able to play the Obscurant demo throughout the entirety of Next Fest (October 1-7).[/h3]

[i]Obscurant is a tile-based mimicry game in which you disguise as your enemy and mimic their behavior to blend in. You play as a curious robot exploring a mysterious world. Observe and blend in to survive.

[list]
[*] Disguise yourself as a variety of unique enemies.
[*] Deceive deadly foes by copying their behavior to blend in.
[*] Discover a mysterious world full of memorable characters.
[/list]

Use the unique mimicry mechanics to sneak past your enemies and find secrets. Record your findings in a player-generated notebook. Learn the origins of the Obscurance, and make friends in a hostile world.[/i]
